text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High 5xx rate on prod gateway — TLS handshake failures (oncall alerted). See alerts: https://alerts.internal/incident/2299999999 :rotating_light:
Alex (oncall): ack — I'm on it, paging SRE + runtime.
Maya (sre): seeing a clear spike in proxy 5xx starting ~14:00 UTC, traces show TLS handshake rejects from several edge nodes. Sample log:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z proxy[edge-7] ERROR tls: TLS handshake error from 10.0.0.5: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-03-15T14:12:04Z proxy[edge-2] ERROR tls: TLS handshake error from 10.0.0.9: remote error: tls: unknown ca
```
Jun (eng-runtime): correlating with rotator deploys — a cert bundle update landed at 14:00 UTC to prod. Could be a chain mismatch or intermediate omitted accidentally.
Lina (eng-security): checking OCSP/KMS — OCSP responder calls returning 500 for the new leaf, KMS decrypts fine. Looks like the uploaded cert bundle may be missing the intermediate CA.
```
$ curl -sS -i https://ocsp.ca.internal/status
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "ocsp_unavailable",
  "details": "intermediate lookup failed"
}
```
Raj (support): we're seeing customer reports from multiple enterprise tenants. Traffic impact estimate: ~6-10% failed requests in EU/US. CS Emily: flagged Priority P1 for impacted enterprise keys, prepping outbound comms.
Alex (oncall): proposed mitigation plan — short term: enable TLS fallback on edge (terminate TLS with previous RSA cert), disable strict mTLS enforcement for backend calls, and roll back rotator cert bundle to previous known-good. Longer term: RCA + add bundle validation to rotator.
Maya (sre): I'm initiating the mitigation steps now. Starting with a feature flag flip to allow TLS fallback and stop rejecting connections on missing intermediate.
```bash
# flip feature flag in control plane
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://console.internal/api/edge/flags \
  -d '{"allow_tls_fallback": true}'
```
deploy-bot: rollout trigger acknowledged — flag set by Alex. :white_check_mark:
Jun (eng-runtime): triggering rotator rollback to previous cert bundle (bundle-id: cb-2026-03-15-0130). Command:
```bash
# trigger rollback via rotator service
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROTATOR" \
  https://rotator.internal/api/v1/rollback \
  -d '{"target_bundle":"cb-2026-03-15-0130"}'
```
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (job-id: rb-9981). Estimated time ~40s.
Maya (sre): also scaling edge proxies to drain bad conns and pick up new certs: kubectl scale --replicas=10 deploy/edge-proxy-prod.
Lina (eng-security): I'm running a quick cert chain check against the currently deployed bundle:
```bash
openssl s_client -connect gateway.prod.internal:443 -showcerts </dev/null 2>/dev/null | sed -n '/BEGIN CERTIFICATE/,/END CERTIFICATE/p' | awk 'NR==1,NR==200{print}'
# observed only 2 certs, expected 3 (missing intermediate)
```
Maya (sre): rollback completed, rotator job rb-9981 finished. Re-deploy on edges in progress. Observability: 5xx rate dropping in US.
Jun (eng-runtime): confirmed new connections have full chain and clients successfully completing ClientHello -> ServerHello. No KMS errors.
Emily (cs): notifying impacted customers via status and direct emails for tenants with support tickets. Template posted: https://status.internal/incidents/2299999999/message-draft
Raj (support): triage note — API keys using mutual TLS with pinned intermediates will need to reconnect; advising clients to retry.
Alex (oncall): temporary config change to relax mTLS enforcement was reverted to strict after health check window?
Maya (sre): we reverted the mTLS relaxation only after verification. Steps timeline: flag flip (14:05 UTC) -> rollback (14:07 UTC) -> scaled proxies/drain (14:07-14:11 UTC) -> verification (14:12-14:14 UTC) -> re-enable strict mTLS (14:15 UTC).
Jun (eng-runtime): Post-mitigation metrics: 5xx rate back to baseline, latency normalized. Sampling of failed requests now below noise floor. Grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/edge/handshake-health - spike visible at 14:00 then recovery by 14:15.
Lina (eng-security): follow-ups: 1) add validation step in rotator to verify full chain and OCSP response pre-publish, 2) add integration test to simulate an intermediate missing scenario.
Alex (oncall): creating follow-up ticket for RCA & process changes. Assigning to Jun + Lina + Maya. Incident severity: Sev2, customer impact moderate but mitigated quickly.
Emily (cs): outbound status update sent. Customers acknowledged.
Raj (support): closing related support escalation tickets as fixed, leaving ones with customer-specific diagnostics open.
Alex (oncall): closing incident channel. Good work team. :rocket: :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident 2299999999 marked resolved at 14:20 UTC. Postmortem requested (owner: Alex).
